narratives.Description: bug(scm,win32): worker-auth T5 fails Step 5 — host gh.exe wins over fake gh.cmd (/user exit 1)
narratives.Overview:
## Summary
Windows `task release` Step 5 fails `worker-auth-cli.integration.test.ts` T5 (assigned host-gh admitted on ambiguous runtime). Exit 2 with `SCM not ready: gh auth status passed but GitHub /user failed: exit 1`. Tip Linux TypeScript CI is green on the same SHA.

## Evidence
- Release cut `0.119.10` Step 5: `Tests 3 failed | 19172 passed` (2026-09-28).
- Isolated: `pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/scm/worker-auth-cli.integration.test.ts` — T5 fails; T1/T2/T4/subdir pass.
- Repro stderr: `gh auth status passed but GitHub /user failed: exit 1`.
- Fake-gh `calls.log` empty in a harness repro → product `which(\"gh\")` likely resolving the real host `gh.exe` instead of the PATH-prepended fake `gh.cmd`.
- Sibling false failures from `DEFT_SKIP_TS_BUILD=1` leaking into `ts-build-fresh.test.ts` (fixed by not exporting that env for Step 5; also harden the test to clear skip in fail cases).

## Acceptance
- [ ] T5 passes on win32 with the existing fake-gh PATH prepend (no host `gh.exe` steal).
- [ ] `ts-build-fresh` fail cases pass even when parent env has `DEFT_SKIP_TS_BUILD=1`.
- [ ] CHANGELOG [Unreleased] Fixed bullet.
- [ ] Windows `task release` Step 5 can proceed past this class (no T5 / ts-build-fresh env false fail).

## Refs
Blocks release `0.119.10`. Child of #5016 / #3663 worker-auth surface.
